input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives Customer an unrestricted termination-for-convenience right over the Agreement or any Order Form, with the notice period fixed at thirty days by Section 29.4, liability limited to accrued Fees (no early-termination fee or penalty), and a refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by Section 10.2). Sections 9.1-9.3 give Vendor only for-cause and insolvency termination rights, and no Vendor convenience or mid-term walk-away right appears anywhere in the document (Section 24.4 expressly denies one on change of control). This matches the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
